metadata.title: RT-qPCR — Relative Gene Expression (MIQE-aligned)
metadata.purpose: Measure the relative expression of a target gene by reverse transcription of RNA to cDNA followed by real-time quantitative PCR, quantified against validated reference gene(s).
metadata.scope: SYBR-Green or hydrolysis-probe RT-qPCR on purified total RNA, using the ddCq relative-quantification method. Reporting follows the MIQE guidelines. Absolute quantification and one-step RT-qPCR are out of scope.
beforeYouBegin: Work RNase-free: dedicated pipettes/tips, gloves, nuclease-free tubes and water.
Validate primer amplification efficiency (90-110%, standard-curve slope about -3.1 to -3.6) and single-product specificity before running experimental samples.
Choose and validate reference gene(s) stable under your conditions (MIQE requires justification of the normaliser).

materials.name: Reverse transcription kit
materials.specification: Reverse transcriptase, RT buffer, dNTPs, RNase inhibitor, primers (oligo-dT / random hexamers)

materials.name: qPCR master mix
materials.specification: SYBR-Green or probe master mix (polymerase, dNTPs, MgCl2, dye/ROX)

steps.action: DNase-treat RNA if not already done.
Assemble the RT reaction with a fixed RNA input across samples.
steps.criticalNotes: Keep reagents on ice; use the same input mass per sample.

parameters.rawText: per kit, e.g. 25 degC prime, 42-50 degC extend, 85 degC inactivate

steps.criticalNotes: Use identical dilution for all samples.
Prepare a master mix; pipette on a cold block.

steps.action: Add template and load the plate.
Run qPCR, then a melt curve (dye-based).

steps.criticalNotes: Positive controls indicate contamination / gDNA carryover.
State the quantification model and efficiency correction.

controls.name: NTC (no-template control)
controls.description: Master mix + water instead of cDNA; detects contamination.

controls.name: Reference gene(s)
controls.description: Validated stable normaliser(s) on the same plate.

controls.name: Inter-run calibrator
controls.description: Common sample across plates for run-to-run comparison.

expectedOutputs: Cq values per well; a single specific product (single melt peak or single band).
Normalised relative expression (fold-change) with amplification efficiency and quantification method reported.

troubleshooting.solution: Fresh reagents; redesign/optimize primers; clean workspace
Repeat DNase treatment; design intron-spanning primers
Optimize annealing temp / primer concentration; validate primers
Increase input; check RIN; clean up RNA; dilute to reduce inhibitors
Use a master mix; increase replicates/input

safety: Standard molecular-biology hygiene; some intercalating dyes are mutagenic - handle and dispose per institutional rules.
limitations: Relative quantification depends on a validated stable reference gene and on primer efficiency; kit-, primer-, and instrument-specific values must be set from the actual reagents used. Biosafety level depends on the RNA source.

sources.title: MIQE Guidelines: Minimum Information for Publication of Quantitative Real-Time PCR Experiments (Bustin et al., Clin Chem 2009)
